title: SiteFlow vs Nway ERP: Why Builders Are Switching to SiteFlow
metaTitle: SiteFlow vs Nway ERP: Why Builders Are Switching to SiteFlow
metaDescription: Compare SiteFlow vs Nway ERP on BOQ-linked execution, face recognition attendance, budget guardrails, and plant tracking to choose the right platform.
author: SiteFlow Operations Team
body: Nway ERP is an enterprise system for construction and real estate organizations covering project management, procurement, finance, payroll, HR, and inventory from one platform. SiteFlow approaches the problem field-first, connecting BOQ, budgeting, labour, materials, procurement, and billing so every task on site immediately shows the project cost position and profitability. Nway suits departmental integration across large entities; SiteFlow closes the gap between site activity and finance visibility in real time.

faqs.q: What is the main difference between SiteFlow and Nway ERP?
faqs.a: Nway ERP is an enterprise system for large infrastructure and road contractors integrating finance, HR, payroll, procurement, inventory, and project management. SiteFlow focuses on field-first execution where every attendance entry, material request, and progress update immediately influences the project cost position and billing readiness.

faqs.q: Does Nway ERP support face recognition attendance?
faqs.a: Nway has an attendance module within its HR and payroll system, but face recognition is not publicly highlighted as a feature. SiteFlow uses AI face recognition with GPS confirmation to verify identity and presence before any payroll entry is created, making proxy and ghost-worker entries structurally impossible.

faqs.q: How does budget control work differently?
faqs.a: SiteFlow enforces spending through workflow approvals that check each request against budget limits at the moment it is raised. Nway provides financial monitoring where budget oversight sits inside accounting and reporting workflows, giving visibility through reports rather than enforcement at commitment.

faqs.q: Which is better for BOQ-driven contracts in India?
faqs.a: SiteFlow is purpose-built for BOQ-driven contracts: every procurement, labour, and cost entry connects back to the original BOQ in real time, and client invoices generate from executed BOQ quantities. Nway builds budgets from broader financial modules rather than the BOQ as a live operational control point.
